description: This file contains functions for configuring trigger shapes for BMW engines within a firmware project, including setup of event timings and shape constraints.

classes.name: TriggerShape
classes.description: A class representing the shape of engine trigger signals, with methods to initialize and add trigger events.

methods.name: float addPair(TriggerShape * s,float a,float w)
methods.description: Inserts a pair of trigger events (rising and falling edges) into a TriggerShape object at specified angles.

methods.name: void configureMiniCooperTriggerShape(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Configures the trigger shape for a Mini Cooper engine by setting timing events based on calculated angles.
